_comment: Example Game Profile - Copy and modify this for your games
_instructions: 1. Copy this file and rename it to your game name (e.g., 'csgo.json')
2. Change 'game_name' to the actual game name
3. Add all possible exe names in 'executable_names' (case insensitive)
5. Adjust priority, affinity, and other settings as needed
6. Restart PartMart Boost to detect the game
